resources.string: Add the Wallet tile to Quick Settings. Tapping it opens Android’s system page for choosing the default Wallet app.
Swipe down twice, tap Edit, then drag “Wallet” into your active Quick Settings tiles.
No NFC, payment, Wallet, or network permission is requested. This app only opens a system settings page.
